title: What If You Could See Like a Bee? 🐝
description:
Bees can see a colour you can't: ultraviolet.
To a bee, a plain yellow sunflower has a giant hidden bullseye, and many flowers have secret landing strips that point to the food. Reindeer see some ultraviolet too, and to them a white wolf looks dark against the snow.

Which animal's eyes would you borrow for a day? Tell us in the comments.

#shorts #science #nature #bees #whatif
facts_checked: Bees see ultraviolet light, which humans cannot; bees cannot see red -> https://www.fs.usda.gov/wildflowers/pollinators/animals/bees.shtml ; https://news.ncsu.edu/2024/07/wms-what-bees-see

Many flowers have UV patterns invisible to us that act as nectar guides / landing zones pointing bees to nectar and pollen -> https://www.fs.usda.gov/wildflowers/pollinators/Plant_Strategies/visualcues.shtml ; https://news.ncsu.edu/2024/07/wms-what-bees-see ; https://www.wildflower.org/magazine/native-plants/a-different-light

Sunflowers look plain yellow to us but have a UV bullseye (UV-absorbing petal bases, UV-reflecting tips) -> https://elifesciences.org/articles/76105 ; https://www.britannica.com/story/the-secret-ultraviolet-colours-of-sunflowers-attract-pollinators-and-preservewater

The human eye's lens filters out UV light before it reaches the retina -> https://www.livescience.com/health/can-humans-see-ultraviolet-light ; https://www.healio.com/news/optometry/20230518/blog-the-link-between-uv-light-iols-and-claude-monets-water-lilies

Reindeer can see ultraviolet (J Exp Biol 2011) -> https://www.news.uwa.edu.au/201105273590/international/reindeer-vision-keeps-wolf-door ; https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/id/eprint/2033 ; https://earthsky.org/earth/reindeer-see-a-twilight-world-in-uv-light/
Snow reflects UV strongly (up to ~80-90%) -> https://www.who.int/uv/faq/whatisuv/en/ ; https://earthsky.org/earth/reindeer-see-a-twilight-world-in-uv-light/

Lichen (reindeer's winter food) absorbs UV and looks dark against snow to reindeer -> https://www.news.uwa.edu.au/201105273590/international/reindeer-vision-keeps-wolf-door ; https://www.atlasobscura.com/articles/reindeer-may-not-be-able-to-fly-but-they-do-have-ultraviolet-vision ; https://earthsky.org/earth/reindeer-see-a-twilight-world-in-uv-light/

Wolf fur absorbs UV, so a white wolf looks dark to a reindeer against UV-bright snow -> https://www.news.uwa.edu.au/201105273590/international/reindeer-vision-keeps-wolf-door ; https://earthsky.org/earth/reindeer-see-a-twilight-world-in-uv-light/
